# Calculate surface energy (divide by 2 for two surfaces)
gamma = delta_E / (2 * A)
print(f"Surface energy: {gamma} eV/Å²")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate surface energy for Aluminum (001) surface
"""

# Data from LAMMPS simulations
E_bulk = -1679.86275358002  # eV
E_surface = -1631.81097242536  # eV
area = 407.8238886225  # Angstrom^2

# Calculate energy difference
delta_E = E_surface - E_bulk

# Surface energy (two surfaces created)
# gamma = (E_surface - E_bulk) / (2 * A)
gamma = delta_E / (2.0 * area)

print(f"Bulk energy: {E_bulk} eV")
print(f"Surface energy: {E_surface} eV")
print(f"Energy difference: {delta_E} eV")
print(f"Surface area: {area} Angstrom^2")
print(f"Number of surfaces: 2")
print(f"Surface energy: {gamma} eV/Angstrom^2")
print(f"Surface energy (formatted): {gamma:.2f}")
